title: Canonical field-spectrum tilde homology comparison
statement: For a commutative ring object k satisfying IsField and integer i, construct a natural isomorphism from termwise tilde, derived localization, degree-i homology and field-spectrum sections to degree-i homology of the original k-module complex. This is actual comparison data, constructed from exactness of sections, not chosen from an unproved existence statement.

source.document: Stacks Project; Mathlib and the existing Lean library

proof.text: Global sections on Spec(k) are an exact equivalence, with associated sheaf as inverse. Compose homologyFunctorFactors, the exact-functor homology comparison and the tilde/sections unit on complexes. Name and keep this construction irreducible, so affine model comparisons can use its stated natural-isomorphism interface without repeatedly unfolding its homology maps.

lean.statement: def residueTildeHomologyComparison (k : CommRingCat.{v}) (hk : IsField k) [HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (Spec k).toRingedSpace))] (i : ℤ) : let B := SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (Spec k).toRingedSpace) let L : ModuleCat.{v} k ⥤ B := tilde.functor k letI : L.Additive := ⟨by intros; exact tilde.map_add _ _⟩ L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor B i ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := k) ≅ HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} k) (.up ℤ) i
